1.40.betting_forecast: 5/1 No Gain, 7/1 Trust Sergei, 8/1 Beerwah, Doralee, Masterclass, 10/1 Auntie Jo, Opal Storm, Vault Of Heaven, 12/1 Canaria
1.40.spotlight_verdict: Several possibles in an open race. Opal Storm, Beerwah, Vault Of Heaven and Isla Bella all come into the reckoning, while Masterclass (second choice) shaped well at Pontefract and is handicapped to win. The drop to 5f is an unknown for NO GAIN but she showed plenty of pace through the middle part of her stable debut last month and she is thoroughly unexposed as a sprinter.[Paul Smith]

2.50.spotlight_verdict: Bunyola Bay may well progress past the standard-setting Deported and rates a major player but the eye is drawn to MOREEDD's sparkling pedigree and he can make a successful debut. Glen Nevis is another newcomer to note.[Paul Smith]

3.25.betting_forecast: 7/4 Silver State, 3/1 Toastmaster, Welbury, 9/1 Saxophonist, 10/1 Booziebrunch, Tarmonbarry Kid, 33/1 Attention Seeker.
3.25.spotlight_verdict: Silver State was impressive at Bath last week but he has faster ground to deal with this time and there are interesting alternatives. Saxophonist and Tarmonbarry Kid (second choice) are potential big improvers now handicapping but WELBURY (nap) is far from exposed himself and he also has the advantage of a run behind him. He can provide the in-form Ed Bethell stable with another winner.[Paul Smith]

4.35.betting_forecast: 7/2 The Jackal, 4/1 Wintercast, 9/2 Bucklow Hill, 6/1 Wayward Queen, 7/1 Roy Lane, 8/1 Masaban, 12/1 King's Road Dandy,
4.35.spotlight_verdict: Wintercast and Wayward Queen are well-bred newcomers to consider, while The Jackal shaped well on last month's debut and is open to improvement, as is Masaban for whom there is a slight query over the drop to 6f. Roy Lane (second choice) can leave his 2yo debut well behind him this year but BUCKLOW HILL looked a useful prospect when winning at Lingfield on his debut and he may defy his penalty.[Paul Smith]

5.10.betting_forecast: 7/2 Kiss For An Angel, 4/1 Brave Leader, 6/1 Berkshire Schmokin, Rumbustious, 7/1 Cotton Bud, Madjid, 12/1 Claytons
5.10.spotlight_verdict: Plenty of these have the potential to kick on again now raised in distance. They include Cotton Bud, Brave Leader (second choice) and KISS FOR AN ANGEL, who has star stayer Kyprios not far back in his pedigree. Tommo's Ginjaninja and Madjid are just two others that need considering in a field of largely unexposed 3yos.[Richard Russell]
